item.text: [{"task_id":"1f0c79e5","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    bg = int(round(params['config'][0]))","    marker = int(round(params['config'][1]))","    size = int(round(params['config'][2]))","    h, w = grid.shape","    out = np.full((h, w), bg % 10, dtype=int)","    if size < 1 or size > min(h, w):","        return out","    occupied = np.argwhere(grid != bg)","    if len(occupied) == 0:","        return out","    top = int(np.min(occupied[:, 0]))","    left = int(np.min(occupied[:, 1]))","    colors = grid[np.logical_and(grid != bg, grid != marker)]","    if len(colors) == 0:","        return out","    color = int(colors[0])","    for r in range(size):","        for c in range(size):","            rr = top + r","            cc = left + c","            if rr >= h or cc >= w:","                continue","            out[rr, cc] = color","            if grid[rr, cc] == marker:","                index = r * size + c","                if index >= len(params['directions']):","                    continue","                dr = int(round(params['directions'][index][0]))","                dc = int(round(params['directions'][index][1]))","                for step in range(max(h, w)):","                    for br in range(size):","                        for bc in range(size):","                            y = top + br + step * dr","                            x = left + bc + step * dc","                            if 0 <= y < h and 0 <= x < w:","                                out[y, x] = color","    return out"],"shapes":{"config":[3],"directions":[4,2]},"params":{"config":[0,2,2],"directions":[[-1,-1],[-1,1],[1,-1],[1,1]]},"rationale":"Recolor the initial 2×2 block with its non-red color. Each red corner projects copies of that block outward along its corner diagonal, forming a three-cell-wide diagonal ray. Combine all rays and clip at the grid boundaries."}]
